## Unknowns

### UNK-001 What one account means

- **Question:** What does "one account" mean in the CIO's mandate: one login, one record or one view across ferry and rail?
- **Owner:** @cio (CIO)
- **State:** open
- **Blocks:** [[01-goals|Goals]]
- **Ask by:** 2026-10-19
- **Opened:** 2026-10-05
- **Notes:** Raised in [[2026-10-05-mandate-meaning#^c02]], [[2026-10-05-mandate-meaning#^c24]] and [[2026-10-05-mandate-meaning#^c28]], and again in [[2026-10-05-systems-run-today#^c13]]. Claude's idea, promoted on a nod: ask the CIO to choose between three short sentences, "one view", "one login" and "one record", and let the answer be the definition ([[2026-10-05-mandate-meaning#^c25]]).

### UNK-002 Overlap and shared emails

- **Question:** How many customers travel on both ferry and rail, and how can they be matched when ferry customers share email addresses and rail customers do not?
- **Owner:** @solution-lead (Solution lead)
- **State:** open
- **Blocks:** [[01-goals|Goals]]
- **Ask by:** 2026-10-26
- **Opened:** 2026-10-05
- **Notes:** Raised in [[2026-10-05-mandate-meaning#^c11]], [[2026-10-05-mandate-meaning#^c13]] and [[2026-10-05-mandate-meaning#^c29]]. The lead is not sure the two sets can be merged without breaking the ferry data.

### UNK-003 Ferry customer data owner

- **Question:** Who owns the ferry customer database now?
- **Owner:** @cio (CIO)
- **State:** open
- **Blocks:** [[concern-data|Data concern]]
- **Ask by:** 2026-10-19
- **Opened:** 2026-10-05
- **Notes:** Raised in [[2026-10-05-mandate-meaning#^c15]]. Nobody named owns it since the merger. SRC-01 also lists the owner as to be confirmed after the reorganisation ([[2026-10-05-systems-run-today#^c11]]).

### UNK-004 DPO proposal before data

- **Question:** What privacy terms apply to linking ferry and rail customers, and what must a proposal to the Data Protection Officer hold before any decision on customer data?
- **Owner:** @solution-lead (Solution lead)
- **State:** open
- **Blocks:** [[01-goals|Goals]], [[concern-data|Data concern]]
- **Ask by:** 2026-10-19
- **Opened:** 2026-10-05
- **Notes:** Raised in [[2026-10-05-mandate-meaning#^c34]], [[2026-10-05-mandate-meaning#^c35]], [[2026-10-05-mandate-meaning#^c40]] and [[2026-10-05-mandate-meaning#^c41]]. The DPO wants to see a proposal first, so this is the first gate on customer data. The lead has not yet spoken to the DPO, so the owner moves to @dpo once they have.

- **Blocks:** [[concern-operations|Operations concern]]
- **Ask by:** 2026-11-02
- **Opened:** 2026-10-05
- **Notes:** Raised in [[2026-10-05-mandate-meaning#^c37]] and [[2026-10-05-mandate-meaning#^c38]]. The lead expects Ferry Ops to refuse to run something they cannot change.

### UNK-008 FERRYMASTER end date

- **Question:** When does FERRYMASTER actually end: March 2029, as the Harbourline systems list says, or December 2027, as the solution lead has heard?
- **Owner:** @solution-lead (Solution lead)
- **State:** open
- **Blocks:** [[03-context-and-scope|Context and scope]]
- **Ask by:** 2026-10-19
- **Opened:** 2026-10-05
- **Notes:** Raised in [[2026-10-05-systems-run-today#^c10]]. SRC-01 gives the vendor contract end as March 2029 with an 18-month notice period. The lead has heard December 2027, which matches the CIO memo of 2026-09-14, not registered as a source. [[03-context-and-scope#Today|Context and scope]] states the March 2029 contract value from SRC-01 only until this is resolved.

### UNK-009 Mainframe key-person cover

- **Question:** Neither of the two people who run the FERRYMASTER mainframe has cover. Who can support it if either leaves before the end of April, and how is that cover secured?
- **Owner:** @ferry-ops-director (Ferry Ops director)
- **State:** open
- **Blocks:** [[concern-operations|Operations concern]], [[02-constraints|Constraints]]
- **Ask by:** 2026-10-09
- **Opened:** 2026-10-05
- **Notes:** Raised in [[2026-10-05-systems-run-today#^c15]]. The lead's reading is that losing either person before April means no access to FERRYMASTER, and with the ferry freeze after April there is no recovery window. The people count (SRC-03) and the lack of cover (SRC-04) are first-hand from the lead, not from a document. The lead checked with the ops team weeks ago and found no cover (SRC-04, first-hand); the lead also reports the ops team told them not to ask, so the ask needs care ([[2026-10-05-systems-run-today#^c16]]). The ask-by moved from 2026-11-02 to 2026-10-09 at the lead's request, because this must be answered before the CIO defines one account ([[2026-10-05-systems-run-today#^c17]]). Related: [[11-unknowns-and-risks#UNK-005 Support during the freeze|UNK-005]].
